summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Mixed Martial Arts Group Limited (NYSE American: MMA) on July 1, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that its BJJLink Connect platform exceeded 17,000 monthly active users and 4,800 peak daily active users. This is a routine operational update on platform traction and user engagement metrics, not a special-situation corporate event. No transaction, structural change, or strategic catalyst is described. The press release highlights validation of the company's community-platform strategy but does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation category. The filing is purely informational and forward-looking in nature.
